:::{#exm-strict-subset-superset}
#### Strict subsets and supersets of die rolls

For the even rolls $A = \set{2, 4, 6}$
and the possible rolls $B = \set{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}$:

- $A \subsetneq B$, because $A \subseteq B$ (@exm-subset) and $1 \in B$ but $1 \notin A$, so $A \neq B$;
- $B \supseteq A$ and $B \supsetneq A$, for the same reasons;
- $B \subseteq B$, but $B$ is not a strict subset of itself, because $B = B$;
  likewise $B \supseteq B$, but $B$ is not a strict superset of itself, because $B = B$.

:::
